release_name: Live TV v5.3.1 (Build 63) — Live Channel Health Audit & Multi-Server Failover
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📺 Complete Channel Health Audit: Diagnosed and repaired all 26 non-playing channels across Bangladesh, Indian Bangla, Sports, and Tennis categories
⚡ 100% Verified Live Streams: Restored Channel 24 HD, Zee Bangla HD, T Sports HD, Star Sports 1 & 2 HD, and beIN Sports 1080p feeds
🛡️ Multi-Server Automated Failover: Added secondary and tertiary high-speed backup servers for uninterrupted playback during network drops
🎾 Tennis Feeds Restored: Switched TSN 1 HD, ESPN 2 Brasil HD, and Tennis Channel to active international feeds
🏏 Live Sports Schedule Synchronization: Fixed multi-day match filtering to guarantee only current, live events are displayed
🏎️ Super-Resolution & Cursor Polish: Retained zero-overhead hidden controls and 60fps hardware acceleration
